label: Prebiotic chemistry
description: Prebiotic synthesis experiments (peptides, nucleotides, ...): one row per experiment sample, with the starting solution chemistry, conditions and measured products. Columns derived from PaperDataTemplate.xlsx (trimmed).

variable_categories.label: Starting Species
variable_categories.description: species in the starting solution (reactants, salts, catalysts, buffers; stock and mixture concentrations) with no column of their own, in mM

variable_categories.label: Kinetics
variable_categories.description: rate constants, rates and half-lives of the reactions, activation energies -- one entry per constant, named by the constant and the reaction it describes

variable_categories.label: Products
variable_categories.description: measured products with no column of their own: concentrations in mM, yields in %, or 'detected'

variable_categories.label: Solution Preparation
variable_categories.description: how the starting solutions were made and combined: volumes added, stock solution concentrations, buffers, degassing

variable_categories.label: Reaction Conditions
variable_categories.description: a quantity the reaction ran under that has no column: reactor or headspace volume, residence time, stirring rate, irradiation wavelength or power (not the reaction time: each row's duration is recorded already)

variable_categories.label: Product Properties
variable_categories.description: measured properties of the products as a whole rather than one species' amount: the longest product detected (in nt or residues), average or typical length, length distribution, linkage ratios (e.g. % 3'-5' bonds), sequence or composition features

variable_categories.label: Analysis
variable_categories.description: how the products were identified and measured, beyond analysis_method: instrument, column, mobile phase or eluent, detection wavelength, standards and calibration, detection limit, sample preparation for analysis

_category_columns: Columns of the dataset in each variable category, for the column order of the CSV and the Rows tab (column_order.py).
